Definition: from a derivative of G5177; fortuitous, i.e. fortunate; Tychicus, a Christian:--Tychicus.
BiblicalUsage: Tychicus is a faithful brother and fellow servant who carried Paul's letters to the churches. In Acts 20:4, of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus. The fuller story is told on the Tychicus profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Tychicus belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
